surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between Ga(N(CH3)2)3 and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: The surface reactions are described as follows: (1a) Ga(N(CH3)2)3 reacts with SH groups, releasing N(CH3)2 ligands. (1b) H2S removes the remaining ligands to form Ga2S3 and repopulate the surface with thiols.
